feeds.title: Art of Adrienne Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Art of Adrienne Blog and view the posts about art in Michigan. Adrienne Gelardi started life as a doodler and appreciator of bright colors, fuzzy animals, and cartoons. She grew up being influenced by her Michigan surroundings and spent time visiting art fairs and seeing shows in vibrant Southeastern Michigan cities like Plymouth, Ann Arbor and Detroit.

feeds.title: Box Factory for the Arts Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest updates from the Box Factory for the Arts. The Box Factory for the Arts provides Southwest Michigan residents, visitors and artists the opportunity to view, for free, quality art exhibits. With a large performance space, the community can also attend events and performances centered around the arts.

feeds.title: Anton Art Center
feeds.description: See what's new at the Anton Art Center. View the latest updates of new exhibitions and prorgams to engage the community with art! Their mission is to enrich and inspire people of all ages through the arts. They want to provide support for the arts and become a focal point for arts programming.

feeds.title: Habatat Detroit Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Habatat was established in 1971 in a suburb of Detroit, Michigan. They are the oldest and largest art gallery in the United States devoted exclusively to artists working with glass as their medium. Habatat Galleries has emerged as a cornerstone in the global glass art community, with a rich history that spans over five decades. Since its inception in 1971, the gallery has played a pivotal role in shaping the landscape of contemporary glass art, hosting exhibitions featuring luminaries like Dale Chihuly and Klaus Moje.

feeds.title: University of Michigan News » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: The University of Michigan News provides you with the latest updates on art and culture. Michigan News promotes innovative research, world-class experts, and Michigan Today and arts & culture at the University of Michigan. Find all the information you need about art in Michigan.

feeds.title: Michigan Public » Arts & Life
feeds.description: Explore Arts, culture, and more from Michigan Public. Michigan Public's mission is to uncover the facts, share the stories, and create the connections that give meaning to the complex world. This is part of the vision for an informed and engaged Michigan.

feeds.title: Michigan State University
feeds.description: Read the latest art-related news from the Michigan State University. The department seeks to integrate the history and practice of art and design into the MSU community, through teaching, research, and public engagement. They further the mission of the arts to deepen understanding of the human condition.

feeds.title: Cranbrook Art Museum
feeds.description: Cranbrook Art Museum presents original exhibitions and educational programming on modern and contemporary architecture, art, crafts, and design. They connect today's diverse and adventuresome artists and audiences with important developments in the arts. They center artists and artworks to drive conversations that inspire us as individuals, cultures, and communities.

feeds.title: Revue Arts » Arts
feeds.description: Explore the blog posts and articles covering performing arts in Michigan. Revue Arts has been West Michigan's Arts & Entertainment Guide for over 30 years. It provides a hyper-local focus on West Michigan's music, nightlife, dining and drinking, cannabis, cultural arts, and entertainment, as well as interesting people, places and products.

feeds.title: Cultivate Blog
feeds.description: Cultivate is an arts organization based in Grand Rapids, Michigan. They offer an art gallery, an arts education space, and an artist resource center. Cultivate, an artist-run nonprofit organization, is dedicated to nurturing creativity, promoting inclusivity, and advocating for the arts.

feeds.title: Peachbelt Studio Blog
feeds.description: Check out the latest posts in the Peachbelt Studio Blog. Explore the annual art gallery and learn more about art. The Peachbelt Studio is an artist-owned studio featuring original oil paintings by Dawn Stafford. The Original oil paintings are exhibited in a rural historic red brick one-room schoolhouse ca 1867, formerly known as the Peachbelt Schoolhouse.

feeds.title: Living Arts Blog
feeds.description: The Living Arts blog provides updates and detailed information on the performing, visual, and media arts programming and events. Living Arts is a Detroit nonprofit located in the heart of Southwest Detroit. Working at the intersection of art and learning, they provide a wide range of arts experiences and arts-integrated education to students as young as 3 months (with caregiver participation) through 18 years.

feeds.title: Three Pines Studio and Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with the art news and gallery updates from Three Pine Studio and Gallery in Cross Village, Michigan. Three Pines is a working studio in the arts and crafts tradition. The Studio features designs by Joann Condino as well as the works of more than 50 other Northern Michigan local artists. The gallery's wide selection of work for sale is based on originality and artistic merit.

feeds.title: Lions & Rabbits Center for the Arts Blog
feeds.description: Find all the information you need about artists and their works. Lions & Rabbits fosters creative community development through strategy, transformative placemaking, and workforce development. They envision a world where creative innovation is at the forefront of community and economic development.

feeds.title: Art Leaders Gallery Blog
feeds.description: View Updates on artists, style trends, and tips for finding the perfect art for your home on the blog page! Art Leaders Gallery is located in the heart of West Bloomfield, Michigan. They have been voted Michigan's Best Fine Art Gallery for their complete fine art services.

feeds.title: West Michigan Center for Arts + Technology
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest news and events in the West Michigan Center for Arts. They provide a culture of opportunity for people to make social and economic progress in their lives and community. They fulfill their mission through visual arts and tech engagement, workforce development and social enterprise.

feeds.title: Park West Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Keep up with Park West Gallery news, artists, exhibits and events with the Park West Gallery blog. At Park West Gallery, they want to get you excited about art. That's been their mission since they were founded in 1969. Park West Gallery believes that art is for everyone— over the past 50 years, they've introduced over 2 million clients to the joys of collecting art.
